verdict.rationale: The evidence says Sai is 'model-agnostic' and lets you choose the planning model, and that it can run on your own Mac or Windows device. Neither statement says a local or self-hosted model is supported, or that device control works without a cloud model API. Model choice and BYOD hardware are adjacent capabilities, and the open-source Agent-S framework is never documented as running on local models, so none of this credits the story.
